auditor_assessment.most_critical_defect: S2 — Exception handler fails open at validate.py:1015-1016. Any runtime error silently disables binding. Attacker who can trigger any exception in the binding check can bypass all validation binding.
auditor_assessment.validation_executor_conclusion_accuracy: inaccurate — tests prove defects, not robustness

scope_violation.description: rig-proof-engineer modified production code (checkpoint.py) beyond test-only lane assignment. Added unconditional preparation_receipt requirement (lines 604-611) that broke all 18 existing checkpoint tests.
scope_violation.resolution: The change aligns with audit invariant but requires: (a) updating all 18 checkpoint tests to include preparation receipts, or (b) making the requirement conditional on operational mode, or (c) reverting the change and deferring to a dedicated implementation slice.
